# `company.purchase_order_conversions`

Immutable record that a purchase order became a bill; unique on both sides.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Permanent conversion ULID. |
| `source_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | purchase_order_revisions.document_id | Purchase order consumed by the bill. |
| `source_revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | purchase_order_revisions.id | Exact purchase order revision the bill was made from. |
| `source_version` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Positive purchase order concurrency version consumed at conversion. |
| `destination_transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | purchase_profiles.transaction_id, transactions.id | Bill created from the purchase order. |
| `destination_revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | purchase_profiles.revision_id | Initial bill revision created from the purchase order. |
| `destination_type` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | transactions.type | Financial destination type; bill is the only implemented one. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase order history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this history. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this conversion. |
